capabilities.notes: R10 has a hash-bound Alpaca SIP daily baseline through 2026-07-17 and a broker-free target observation path. That frozen historical bundle is warmup evidence only; no post-epoch session, current broker snapshot, official auction mark, or paper fill has been collected.

market_data_limitations: The baseline bundle is locally immutable but is ignored by Git and has no configured durable artifact store.
Forward observation begins on 2026-07-20; the current bundle ends on 2026-07-17 and contributes zero forward sessions.
Alpaca SIP bars do not by themselves attest primary-exchange official opening-auction prices or broker fills.
